result_text:
I rewrote the `validate_url` test so it no longer uses mocks, which should clear the stop-hook failure. I didn't re-run the hook to confirm. The tests pass (44), and ruff check and format are clean.

The test now calls `validate_url("https://[64:ff9b:1::a9fe:a9fe]/path")` directly. An IPv6 literal resolves without a DNS lookup, so the mock count in the file goes back to 68.
